profileSleep.title: Sleep pattern

weightCalibration.title: Weight calibration
weightCalibration.intro: Weigh yourself at different times and under different conditions — this gives you a sense of your fluctuation throughout the day, without having to weigh yourself naked every time.

targetWeight.title: Goal
targetWeight.intro: Set the weight you're aiming for. Used to track your progress in the statistics.

weightLog.intro: Log your weight. It's saved right away and shows up in the calendar and statistics.
